name: Revival Altar
pages: The Revival Altar is a multiblock that is used to $(l)$(#5f1912)revive the dead$(). all you have to do is $(l)$(#5f1912)sacrifice$() one of your hearts. $(br)The Revival Altar has 2 uses:$(li)Healing: If the multiblock is constructed correctly it will provide regeneration to anyone withing it's range.$(li)Reviving the dead: To revive a friend you must use a $(#5f1912)Heart Extractor$() to get a $(#5f1912)Hardcore Heart$() $(br)Once you have a $(#5f1912)Hardcore Heart$() just plop it into the Revival Altar and any $(l)$(7)ghosts$() nearby shall be $(l)$(#5f1912)reincarnated$().
